policy_expected_codes.source_text: Z79.85: Long-term use of injectable non-insulin antidiabetic drugs (e.g., Ozempic®, Trulicity®, Victoza®, etc.)

criteria.label: Type II Diabetes Mellitus confirmed
criteria.evidence_summary: HbA1c 8.2% on 03/14/2024; ICD-10 E11.9 documented since 2019; fasting glucose 187 mg/dL

criteria.label: Patient age meets minimum threshold (18 years)
criteria.evidence_summary: DOB 03/14/1972; age 52 at time of request; Cigna Ozempic minimum age 18 years

criteria.label: No concurrent GLP-1 or GLP-1/GIP agonist on active medication list
criteria.evidence_summary: Active list reviewed 03/14/2024: metformin, lisinopril, atorvastatin — no other GLP-1/GIP agent

criteria.label: Indication limited to glycemic management in Type II Diabetes
criteria.evidence_summary: Chart includes BMI 33.2 kg/m2 and 'weight management goals discussed' note 01/10/2024; payer requires clarification that Ozempic is prescribed solely for T2DM glycemic control

policy_expected_codes.source_text: K21.0: Gastro-esophageal reflux disease with oesophagitis

criteria.label: GERD or erosive esophagitis diagnosis documented
criteria.evidence_summary: Endoscopy 11/15/2023: Los Angeles Grade A esophagitis; ICD-10 K21.0 confirmed

criteria.label: Patient age 6 or older (auto-process exemption does not apply)
criteria.evidence_summary: DOB 09/22/2017; age 7 at time of request; step therapy criteria applicable

criteria.label: Documented failure of omeprazole, pantoprazole, and rabeprazole
criteria.evidence_summary: Omeprazole 10 mg x 8 weeks failed (documented); pantoprazole and rabeprazole not documented; UHC requires failure of all three agents

criteria.label: Documented oral-motor dysphagia or swallowing limitation
criteria.evidence_summary: SLP 12/02/2023: dysphagia confirmed, cannot swallow tablets; vs. chart note 01/15/2024: 'tolerating crushed omeprazole without difficulty'

policy_expected_codes.source_text: K74.3: Primary biliary cirrhosis (Primary Biliary Cholangitis — PBC). Note: K83.01 (Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis) is a different biliary disease and must NOT be used for PBC.

criteria.label: Primary Biliary Cholangitis confirmed (ALP elevated, AMA positive)
criteria.evidence_summary: ALP 198 U/L (ref <115); AMA positive (titer 1:640); meets AASLD 2021 criteria (2 of 3 present)

criteria.label: Patient age 18 or older
criteria.evidence_summary: DOB 11/07/1970; age 54 at time of request

criteria.label: No current or prior hepatic decompensation
criteria.evidence_summary: No ascites, variceal bleeding, or hepatic encephalopathy through 03/2024; MELD score 9

criteria.label: Gastroenterologist or hepatologist prescriber
criteria.evidence_summary: Dr. Samuel Okonkwo, MD — Hepatology; NPI 3456789012; board-certified

criteria.label: UDCA therapy for 12 or more months with inadequate response
criteria.evidence_summary: Ursodiol initiated 06/15/2023; duration at PA request (02/20/2024) ~8 months; ALP still elevated but 12-month minimum not yet reached

policy_expected_codes.source_text: Z79.85: Long-term use of injectable non-insulin antidiabetic drugs (e.g., Ozempic®, Trulicity®, Victoza®, etc.)
